CALIPER DISASSEMBLY

Assembly is in the reverse order of disassembly.
ASSEMBLY NOTICE: Apply lithium soap base glycol grease to the parts indicated by the arrows (See page BR–31)

1. REMOVE CYLINDER BOOT SET RINGS AND BOOTS
Using a screwdriver, remove the 2 cylinder boot set rings and 2 boots.

2. REMOVE PISTONS FROM CYLINDER
(a) Prepare a wooden plate to hold the pistons.

(b) Place the plate between the pistons and insert a pad on one side.
(c) Use compressed air to remove the pistons alternately from the caliper.
DISASSEMBLY CAUTION: Do not place your fingers in front of the pistons when using compressed air.

3. REMOVE PISTON SEALS
Using a screwdriver, remove the 2 seals from the cylinder.
